newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 17.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 17.

text.p: -- Motorola Inc plans to launch a $12.9 billion satellite network to deliver high-speed data and video to businesses, broadcasters and telecommunication companies, according to the Wall Street Journal.

-- AMR Corp's domestic carrier American Eagle said it placed a $1 billion order for short-range passenger jets with Brazilian aircraft maker Embraer. The company also ordered up to 50 jets from Canada's Bombardier.
-- Micron Technology posted third-quarter earnings of $96.8 million, or $0.44 per share, up from $58.2 million, or $0.27 per share, a year earlier. Sales rose to $965 million from $771 million.
